summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for cache trace dataset preprocessing (filtering by request threshold, normalizing trace length metrics). It operates in the data_preparation task_family at the preprocessing stage, with no semantic overlap to existing skills which cover buffer timeout configuration, thread pool submission, and cache algorithm analysis. The peer_candidates are all cache algorithm evaluation skills (different task_family: cache_algorithm_analysis, cache_performance_analysis, cache_configuration) and do not subsume this data preparation capability. Support evidence confirms the 1M request filtering threshold and trace normalization as documented practice.
